9711.en: The Razuka, the mighty paw of the land!
9711.zh: 拉祖卡，這片土地的強大之爪！

9801.en: I am Lord Galiere, Defender of the Gorn Domains!
9801.zh: 我是加利爾領主，高恩領土的防衛者！

9802.en: I am Defender of the Gorn Domains!
9802.zh: 我是高恩領土的防衛者！

9803.en: We stand at the border of the lands of the Gorn Empire!
9803.zh: 我們正站在高恩帝國領土的邊界上！

9812.en: You'd best hurry with your news to the King!

10927.en: Those that walk the holy path shall know the way!

10932.en: We walk the path of the Holy Work, teachings of the divine Munkharam!
10932.zh: 我們行走聖工之路，神聖穆克哈拉姆的教誨！

10933.en: Those who walk the holy path live the Holy Work!

10941.en: To walk the land of dreams seek the Palace of Munkharama...
10941.zh: 想行走夢土，就尋訪僧侶聖地的宮殿……

10952.en: The Holy City of Munkharama, the city of the Holy Work...
10952.zh: 聖城僧侶聖地，聖工之城……

10953.en: The Holy City of Munkharama lies east of the Eyrn River...
10953.zh: 聖城僧侶聖地位於艾恩河以東……

10956.en: The divine prophet of all Munk, the holy Munkharam!
10956.zh: 全體穆克的神聖先知，神聖的穆克哈拉姆！

10958.en: The divine Munkharam leads all who walk the holy path...
10958.zh: 神聖的穆克哈拉姆引領所有行走聖道的人……

10961.en: The insane Lord of the House of Dane, defiler of the Holy Work!
10961.zh: 丹恩家病態的主子，聖工的褻瀆者！

10963.en: He performs unholy rituals high atop the Tower of Dionysceus...
10963.zh: 他從狄奧尼修斯塔頂施行邪穢的儀式……

10971.en: Beware the lying deceit and treachery of Kymas Turan!
10971.zh: 當心基馬斯·圖蘭的謊言、欺瞞與背叛！

10973.en: Kymas Turan flings his iniquitous filth upon all who come near...
10973.zh: 基馬斯·圖蘭把他的邪惡穢物潑向所有靠近的人……

10976.en: The misguided Brothers of Dane, may we purge the lands of their evil!
10976.zh: 丹恩家那群誤入歧途的修士，願我們肅清其邪惡！

10978.en: They spread their evil words from the unholy Tower of Dionysceus...
10978.zh: 他們從邪穢的狄奧尼修斯之塔散播邪惡……

11012.en: The life of the unfortunate is not easy...
11012.zh: 不幸之人的人生不好過……

11013.en: Such a secret is worth keeping!

11017.en: What you need are some special charms!
11017.zh: 你需要一些特殊的護符！

11018.en: Perhaps you should shoppe at Ratskell's!
11018.zh: 也許你該去拉茨克爾店逛逛！

11026.en: Ratskell's has many unusual items to help supplement your skills...
11026.zh: 拉茨克爾店有許多珍奇貨品，可輔助你的技能……

11037.en: I'd prefer not to talk about it...

11046.en: The Razuka, bosses of the underworld!
11046.zh: 拉祖卡，地下世界的老大們！

11048.en: It's rumored that the Razuka hole up in the old Funhouse...
11048.zh: 謠傳拉祖卡窩藏在老玩笑屋裡……

11061.en: Don Barlone', ruthless head of the Razuka!
11061.zh: 唐·巴隆內，拉祖卡冷酷的首腦！

11063.en: It's rumored that the Razuka hole up in the old Funhouse...
11063.zh: 謠傳拉祖卡窩藏在老玩笑屋裡……

11067.en: Masters of the trade belong to the Guild...
11067.zh: 這一行的頂尖好手都屬於公會……

11072.en: Ratskell's, the guild of all thieves!
11072.zh: 拉茨克爾店，眾盜賊的公會！

11086.en: He died long ago, I know nothing else...
11086.zh: 他很久以前就死了，其他我一無所知……

11091.en: Ratsputin, the gathering paw of the Razuka!
11091.zh: 鼠拉斯普丁，拉祖卡的召集之爪！

11093.en: He's making the rounds, I'm sure!

11096.en: Mick the Pick, fleetest of them all!
11096.zh: 撬鎖米克，身手最矯捷的一個！

11101.en: Bertie has lots of sharp goodies for sale...
11101.zh: 伯蒂有好多鋒利的好貨要賣……

11103.en: Bertie's shoppe, around and over, through and up, can't miss it!
11103.zh: 伯蒂的店，繞過去再上去，穿過去爬上來，不會錯過的！

11107.en: Our home here in the forest...

11108.en: In the woods, down the valley, through the vale, over the mountains!
11108.zh: 在樹林裡，下到谷底，穿過谷地，翻過群山！

11201.en: I'm Sergeant Kabomm, head of the Supply Depot...
11201.zh: 我是卡邦姆中士，補給庫的主管……

11203.en: If you need gear or ammo, you'll find me here at the Supply Depot...
11203.zh: 需要裝備或彈藥，就到補給庫來找我……

11212.en: The Supply Depot is where all I.U.F.'s requisition gear and ammo...
11212.zh: 補給庫是 I.U.F. 將士請領裝備彈藥的地方……

11213.en: If you need some additional supplies, just let me know...
11213.zh: 需要額外的補給品就告訴我……

11217.en: I've got all kinds of gear for the well-equipped soldier!
11217.zh: 各種裝備應有盡有，讓士兵武裝齊全！

11218.en: Take a look at what I've got and let me know if you want something...
11218.zh: 看看我的貨，想要什麼就說一聲……

11219.en: The only supplies I have are kept here at the Depot...
11219.zh: 我僅有的補給品都存放在補給庫……

11231.en: If you want to learn to shoot, go practice at the Firing Range...
11231.zh: 想學射擊，就去射擊場練習……

11242.en: You need to put in your target practice at the Firing Range...
11242.zh: 你得去射擊場好好練打靶……

11243.en: See Lieutenant Gromo, he'll set you up with targets...
11243.zh: 找格羅莫中尉，他會幫你安排靶子……

11244.en: It's across from the North Barracks, just over that-a-way...
11244.zh: 就在北營房對面，往那邊走就是……

11246.en: He's at the Firing Range... &Now either buy something or scram...
11246.zh: 他在射擊場……&要買就買，不然就滾……

11251.en: I hear our forces are tracking a band of spies in our midst!
11251.zh: 聽說我軍正在追查混進我們之中的間諜！

11256.en: General Yamo, Commander of the I.U.F., Imperial Umpani Forces!
11256.zh: 亞莫將軍，恩帕尼帝國軍 I.U.F. 的統帥！

11258.en: His office is over at the I.U.F. Command Headquarters...
11258.zh: 他的辦公室在 I.U.F. 指揮總部……

11261.en: Rodan Lewarx, Master Tracker under the command of General Yamo...
11261.zh: 羅丹·勒瓦克斯，亞莫將軍麾下的追蹤大師……

11263.en: Laying a trap for the wretched T'Rang insects, I hope!
11263.zh: 希望是在給卑劣的特蘭格蟲子設陷阱！

11266.en: Tracker Rhallick is a scout for the I.U.F...
11266.zh: 追蹤者拉利克是 I.U.F. 的斥候……

11268.en: Laying a trap for the wretched T'Rang insects, I hope!
11268.zh: 希望是在給卑劣的特蘭格蟲子設陷阱！

11271.en: Lt. Gruntwrapper is under special orders from General Yamo...
11271.zh: 格蘭特瑞普中尉奉亞莫將軍的特殊命令行事……

11273.en: I haven't seen him around lately...

11276.en: Rossarian is a swarthy trader, who came here for his own reasons...
11276.zh: 羅薩里安是個膚色黝黑的商人，為了自己的緣故來到此地……

11278.en: I've heard he's been seen around New City...
11278.zh: 聽說有人在新城一帶看過他……

11281.en: Sgt. Balbrak is the Recruiting Officer, in charge of enlistments...
11281.zh: 巴布拉克中士是募兵官，負責招募入伍……

11283.en: Why don't you try looking for him down at the Recruiting Station...
11283.zh: 何不去募兵站那裡找找他……

11287.en: I.U.F., that stands for Imperial Umpani Forces!

11288.en: The I.U.F. is always looking for a few good snouts!
11288.zh: I.U.F. 永遠在找幾個好鼻子！

11297.en: Ukpyr is our temporary Command Headquarters on this planet...
11297.zh: 烏克皮爾是我們在這顆行星上的臨時指揮總部……

11298.en: Ukpyr is just this side of the Ukpyr Mountains...
11298.zh: 烏克皮爾就在烏克皮爾山脈的這一側……

11306.en: I've heard there's a Black Market operating in New City somewhere...
11306.zh: 聽說新城某處有個黑市在營業……

11311.en: Death to the T'Rang vermin, destroyer of worlds!
11311.zh: 去死吧，特蘭格害蟲，世界的毀滅者！

11313.en: Everywhere, but one day we shall rid the universe of their kind!
11313.zh: 無所不在，但總有一天我們會把他們從宇宙清除！

11402.en: I am master of T'Rang assassins...
11402.zh: 我是特蘭格刺客的首領……

11403.en: My plans are not for you to know...

11411.en: The great H'Jenn-Ra, Lord of T'Rang, is very wise...
11411.zh: 偉大的赫詹拉，特蘭格之主，非常有智慧……

11413.en: H'Jenn-Ra is safely guarded in the northern lands...
11413.zh: 赫詹拉在北方之地受到嚴密保護……

11416.en: K'Borra T'Rang is the cunning lacky of H'Jenn-Ra...
11416.zh: 克波拉·特蘭格是赫詹拉狡詐的走狗……

11421.en: D'Rang T'Rang is the reckless young nephew of K'Borra T'Rang...
11421.zh: 德朗·特蘭格是克波拉·特蘭格魯莽的年輕姪子……

11427.en: Hsssst! You would do well to keep silent about this...
11427.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！這件事你最好保持緘默……

11432.en: Hsssst! You would do well to keep silent about this...
11432.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！這件事你最好保持緘默……

11437.en: The northern ruins of Nyctalinth serves as our temporary base...
11437.zh: 北方的夜螢城遺跡是我們的臨時基地……

11438.en: Nyctalinth lies north of the Red Forest...
11438.zh: 夜螢城位於赤色森林以北……

11441.en: General Yamo is the fat-bellied commander of the Umpani toads!
11441.zh: 亞莫將軍是恩帕尼蟾蜍的大肚皮指揮官！

11443.en: He cowers in the jungles of the east, in the Ukpyr Mountains...
11443.zh: 他龜縮在東方的叢林裡，烏克皮爾山脈之中……

11451.en: Do not mention this name again...

11456.en: If you know of the legendary globe, tell me more...
11456.zh: 若你知曉那顆傳說中的球體，多告訴我一些……

11461.en: Hssst-Heh heh... &It gave me great pleasure to watch him suffer!
11461.zh: 嘶嘶——嘿嘿……&看著他受苦，真讓我心花怒放！

11501.en: I am K'Borra T'Rang, mighty claw of the great H'Jenn-Ra...
11501.zh: 我是克波拉·特蘭格，偉大赫詹拉的強悍之爪……

11503.en: My plans are not for you to know...

11511.en: K'Borra T'Rang does not presume to speak for the great H'Jenn-Ra...
11511.zh: 克波拉·特蘭格豈敢代偉大的赫詹拉發言……

11513.en: H'Jenn-Ra commands from our outpost in the northern lands...
11513.zh: 赫詹拉在北方之地的前哨坐鎮指揮……

11516.en: The mighty Shritis T'Rang, leader of assasins!
11516.zh: 強大的希里提斯·特蘭格，刺客之首！

11517.en: The great T'Rang assassin leads a special mission for the Empire...
11517.zh: 偉大的特蘭格刺客正為帝國執行一項特殊任務……

11518.zh: 希里提斯行事，只憑自己高興……

11521.en: D'Rang T'Rang is my strong and clever young nephew...
11521.zh: 德蘭·特蘭格是我強壯又機靈的年輕姪子……

11523.en: D'Rang is no doubt sending the Umpani toads fleeing, even as we speak!
11523.zh: 此時此刻，德蘭肯定正把恩帕尼蟾蜍殺得落荒而逃！

11527.en: Hsssst! You would do well to keep silent about this...
11527.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！這件事你最好保持緘默……

11532.en: Hsssst! You would do well to keep silent about this...
11532.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！這件事你最好保持緘默……

11537.en: The northern ruins of Nyctalinth serves as our temporary base...
11537.zh: 北方的夜螢城遺跡是我們的臨時基地……

11538.en: Nyctalinth lies north of the Red Forest...
11538.zh: 夜螢城位於赤色森林以北……

11541.en: General Yamo is the fat-bellied commander of the Umpani toads!
11541.zh: 亞莫將軍是恩帕尼蟾蜍的大肚皮指揮官！

11543.en: He cowers in the jungles of the east, in the Ukpyr Mountains...
11543.zh: 他龜縮在東方的叢林裡，烏克皮爾山脈之中……

11546.en: Rodan Lewarx is the master tracker for the blubbering Umpani cows!
11546.zh: 羅丹·勒瓦克斯是那些哭嚎恩帕尼母牛的追蹤大師！

11548.en: If I could find him, I would destroy him!
11548.zh: 只要能找到他，我必毀了他！

11551.en: Do not mention this name again...

11556.en: If you know of the legendary globe, tell me more...
11556.zh: 若你知曉那顆傳說中的球體，多告訴我一些……

11561.en: I do not know of what you speak... &Let us not talk of this further...
11561.zh: 我不知道你在說什麼……&這件事就別再說了……

11601.en: I am D'Rang T'Rang, important leader in the T'Rang Empire...
11601.zh: 我是德蘭·特蘭格，特蘭格帝國舉足輕重的領袖……

11603.en: I seek out the whimpering Umpani hogs, to destroy them!
11603.zh: 我專門追獵那些哀嚎的恩帕尼肥豬，消滅他們！

11611.en: The great H'Jenn-Ra, Lord of T'Rang, is very wise...
11611.zh: 偉大的赫詹拉，特蘭格之主，非常有智慧……

11613.en: H'Jenn-Ra is safely guarded in the northern lands...
11613.zh: 赫詹拉在北方之地受到嚴密保護……

11616.en: The mighty Shritis T'Rang, leader of assassins!
11616.zh: 強大的希里提斯·特蘭格，刺客之首！

11617.en: The great T'Rang assassin leads a special mission for the Empire...
11617.zh: 偉大的特蘭格刺客正為帝國執行一項特殊任務……

11618.zh: 希里提斯行事，只憑自己高興……

11621.en: K'Borra T'Rang is my uncle, second only to the great H'Jenn-Ra...
11621.zh: 克波拉·特蘭格是我的叔叔，地位僅次於偉大的赫詹拉……

11623.en: K'Borra T'Rang is laying a trap for the blundering Umpani cows!
11623.zh: 克波拉·特蘭格正在給莽撞的恩帕尼母牛設下陷阱！

11627.en: That is our space shuttle... &Hssst! How do you know of this?
11627.zh: 那是我們的太空梭……&嘶嘶！你怎麼會知道這件事？

11632.en: Hsssst! You would do well to keep silent about this...
11632.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！這件事你最好保持緘默……

11637.en: The northern ruins of Nyctalinth serves as our temporary base...
11637.zh: 北方的夜螢城遺跡是我們的臨時基地……

11638.en: Nyctalinth lies north of the Red Forest...
11638.zh: 夜螢城位於赤色森林以北……

11641.en: General Yamo is the fat-bellied commander of the Umpani toads!
11641.zh: 亞莫將軍是恩帕尼蟾蜍的大肚皮指揮官！

11643.en: He cowers in the jungles of the east, in the Ukpyr Mountains...
11643.zh: 他龜縮在東方的叢林裡，烏克皮爾山脈之中……

11646.en: Rodan Lewarx is the master tracker for the blubbering Umpani cows!
11646.zh: 羅丹·勒瓦克斯是那些哭嚎恩帕尼母牛的追蹤大師！

11648.en: If I could find him, I would destroy him!
11648.zh: 只要能找到他，我必毀了他！

11651.en: I am not afraid of this Dark Savant, let him show his face to D'Rang!
11651.zh: 我才不怕什麼黑暗賢者，叫他來向德蘭露臉吧！

11653.en: I have not seen him... &They say he rides upon his black ship...
11653.zh: 我沒見過他……&據說他乘著他的黑船……

11656.en: If you know of the legendary globe, tell me more...
11656.zh: 若你知曉那顆傳說中的球體，多告訴我一些……

11662.en: The Black Ship, vessel of the Dark Savant, known as the Dedaelis...
11662.zh: 黑船，黑暗賢者的座艦，人稱迪達利斯……

11663.en: Up there somewhere, I am told...

11701.en: I am Rodan Lewarx, son of Hector, Master of all Umpani Trackers...
11701.zh: 我是羅丹·勒瓦克斯，赫克特之子，恩帕尼全體追蹤者的大師……

11702.en: I seek the head of Shritis T'Rang, vengeance shall be mine!!
11702.zh: 我要取希里提斯·特蘭格的項上人頭，血債必償！！

11712.en: He is dead by the claw of an assassin, the claw of Shritis T'Rang!
11712.zh: 他死於刺客之爪——希里提斯·特蘭格的爪下！

11716.en: General Yamo is the current Commander-In-Chief of the I.U.F....
11716.zh: 亞莫將軍是 I.U.F. 現任的最高統帥……

11718.en: Command headquarters, at the base in Ukpyr...
11718.zh: 指揮總部，就在烏克皮爾的基地……

11721.en: Tracker Rhallick is a scout for the I.U.F...
11721.zh: 追蹤者拉利克是 I.U.F. 的斥候……

11723.en: Laying a trap for the wretched T'Rang insects, I hope!
11723.zh: 希望是在給卑劣的特蘭格蟲子設陷阱！

11726.en: Lt. Gruntwrapper is under special orders from General Yamo...
11726.zh: 格蘭特拉普中尉奉亞莫將軍的特殊命令行事……

11731.en: Rossarian is a swarthy trader, who came here for his own reasons...
11731.zh: 羅薩里安是個膚色黝黑的商人，為了自身的緣故來到此地……

11733.en: Rumors have it that he is running a Black Market out of New City...
11733.zh: 謠傳他在新城經營著一處黑市……

11736.en: He's an officer in the I.U.F...
11736.zh: 他是 I.U.F. 的一名軍官……

11738.en: He was at our base in Ukpyr, the last time I saw him...
11738.zh: 上次見到他時，他就在我們烏克皮爾的基地……

11752.en: I.U.F., that stands for Imperial Umpani Forces!

11753.en: The I.U.F. Command Headquarters is at our base in Ukpyr...
11753.zh: I.U.F. 指揮總部就在我們烏克皮爾的基地……

11762.en: Ukpyr is the location of our Command Headquarters...
11762.zh: 烏克皮爾是我們指揮總部的所在地……

11763.en: Ukpyr is east through the jungles, this side of the Ukpyr Mountains...
11763.zh: 烏克皮爾往東穿過叢林，在烏克皮爾山脈的這一側……

11772.en: If you don't know, I can't help you...
11772.zh: 你不知道的話，我幫不上忙……

11773.en: Travel to our base in Ukpyr, they can direct you from there...
11773.zh: 去我們烏克皮爾的基地，那裡的人能為你指路……

11786.en: I've heard there's a Black Market operating in New City somewhere...
11786.zh: 聽說新城某處有個黑市在營業……

11791.en: I shall not rest until all T'Rang are eliminated!
11791.zh: 不把特蘭格斬草除根，我絕不罷休！

11793.en: Everywhere, but one day we shall rid the universe of their kind!
11793.zh: 無所不在，但總有一天我們會把他們從宇宙清除！

11796.en: H'Jenn-Ra is the diseased head of the T'Rang...
11796.zh: 赫詹拉是特蘭格病態的禍首……

11797.en: H'Jenn-Ra spreads the T'Rang filth throughout the galaxy!
11797.zh: 赫詹拉把特蘭格的穢物散播到整個銀河！

11798.en: The disgusting T'Rang bugs are burrowed up north somewhere...
11798.zh: 噁心的特蘭格蟲子正窩藏在北方某處……

11811.en: This is a name to beware, he is more powerful than any suspect!
11811.zh: 這名字要當心，他比任何人想像的都強大！

11813.en: They say his black ship looms behind every dark cloud of the sky...
11813.zh: 據說他的黑船潛伏在天上每一朵烏雲之後……

11817.en: The Black Ship, dreadnaught vessel of the Dark Savant!
11817.zh: 黑船，黑暗賢者的無畏艦！

11818.en: I've heard that the Black Ship is close, very close...
11818.zh: 聽說黑船已經很近了，非常近……

12301.en: I am King Ulgar, ruler of the Gorn Empire!
12301.zh: 我是烏爾加王，高恩帝國的統治者！

12302.en: I seek to save our Empire from the tragedy of Civil War!
12302.zh: 我要拯救帝國，使其免於內戰的悲劇！

12303.en: I shall travel the lands, and weave my own plans!
12303.zh: 我將行走各地，編織我自己的計畫！

12311.en: Lord Galiere, the regal vassal, loyal to my throne!
12311.zh: 加列爾勳爵，尊貴的封臣，忠於我的王座！

12312.en: He gives his sword to preserve the kingdom of Gorn!
12312.zh: 他奉上長劍，為保全高恩王國！

12314.en: He is attempting to thwart the Civil War that plagues the land of Gorn!
12314.zh: 他正設法阻止蹂躪高恩大地的內戰！

12316.en: He disappeared not long ago, and we fear for the worst!
12316.zh: 他不久前失蹤了，我們擔心最壞的情況！

12321.en: Alas, poor wizard Murkatos, the betrayer betrayed!
12321.zh: 唉，可憐的法師穆卡托斯，叛徒反遭背叛！

12322.en: Poor Murkatos, once the great Wizard of Gorn, now a pile of bones...
12322.zh: 可憐的穆卡托斯，昔日的高恩大法師，如今一堆白骨……

12331.en: Orkogre Castle, now lying steeped in the blood of Gorn!
12331.zh: 奧高高城，如今浸在高恩的血泊之中！

12341.en: Damn the prophecies, I will have my kingdom restored!
12341.zh: 去他的預言，我一定要重掌王國！

12347.en: Civil War now ravages our land and army, the fall of the Gorn Empire!
12347.zh: 內戰正肆虐我國的國土與軍隊，高恩帝國就要傾覆了！

12348.en: The Civil War that tears our lands, and rips the kingdom apart!

12351.en: T'would destory the plan, should I let it pass my lips!

12502.zh: 我要拯救帝國，使其免於內戰的悲劇！

12531.zh: 奧高高城堡，如今浸在高恩的血泊之中！

12541.zh: 眼前開展的一切，無非預言應驗！

12547.zh: 內戰如今肆虐我國土與軍隊，高恩帝國已然傾覆！

12548.zh: 內戰撕裂我方國土，令王國分崩離析！

12551.zh: 那些處心積慮想毀滅高恩國的人！

12552.en: All were deceived, and now all do suffer!
12552.zh: 眾人皆受騙，如今皆受苦！

12553.en: Out there, somewhere, and I shall find them!
12553.zh: 他們就在某處，我一定會找到！

12601.zh: 我是鄭大師，五花門之主……

12602.en: I teach the school of 5 Flowers, and the way of the Holy Work...
12602.zh: 我傳授五花門，以及聖工之道……

12603.en: I walk the lands to teach the way of the Holy Work!
12603.zh: 我行走各地，傳授聖工之道！

12611.en: Brother TShober guards the Bridge to Munkharama...
12611.zh: 喬伯修士守衛通往僧侶聖地的橋……

12616.en: Father Rulae leads those who would walk the holy path!
12616.zh: 魯萊神父引領欲行聖道之人！

12618.en: He spends his days at Thesminster Abbey, in New City...
12618.zh: 他終日在新城的塞斯敏斯特修道院……

12621.en: I heard he makes very bad tea!

12623.en: He attends the Apothecary in Munkharama...
12623.zh: 他在僧侶聖地的藥鋪做事……

12626.en: To walk the land of dreams seek the Palace of Munkharama...
12626.zh: 欲踏上夢土，請尋訪僧侶聖地的宮殿……

12637.en: The Holy City of Munkharama, the city of the Holy Work...
12637.zh: 僧侶聖地這座聖城，正是聖工之城……

12638.en: The Holy City of Munkharama lies east of the Eyrn River...
12638.zh: 僧侶聖地聖城位於厄恩河以東……

12641.en: All good brothers walk the holy path!
12641.zh: 所有良善修士皆行聖道！

12642.en: Those who would live the Holy Work, walk the holy path!
12642.zh: 想踐行聖工的人，要走聖道！

12643.en: Father Rulae of Thesminster Abbey shows the way of the holy path...
12643.zh: 塞斯敏斯特修道院的魯萊神父會指引聖道……

12647.en: We walk the path of the Holy Work, teachings of the divine Munkharam!
12647.zh: 我們走聖工之路，那是神聖穆克哈拉姆的教誨！

12648.en: Those who walk the holy path live the Holy Work!

12656.en: The divine prophet of all Munk, the holy Munkharam!
12656.zh: 全穆克的神聖先知，神聖的穆克哈拉姆！

12658.en: The divine Munkharam leads all who walk the holy path...
12658.zh: 神聖的穆克哈拉姆引領所有行聖道者……

12661.en: The misguided Brothers of Dane, may we purge the lands of their filth!
12661.zh: 誤入歧途的丹恩弟兄，願我們淨化其污穢！

12663.en: They spread their wickedness from the unholy Tower of Dionysceus...
12663.zh: 他們自邪穢的狄奧尼修斯之塔散播邪惡……

12666.en: The diseased Lord of the House of Dane, defiler of the Holy Work!
12666.zh: 染病的丹恩家族之主，聖工的褻瀆者！

12668.en: He practices his unholy rituals from atop the Tower of Dionysceus...
12668.zh: 他在狄奧尼修斯之塔頂舉行邪穢儀式……

12676.en: Beware the lying deceit and treachery of Kymas Turan!
12676.zh: 當心基馬斯圖蘭的謊言、欺瞞與背叛！

12678.en: Kymas Turan flings his iniquitous filth upon all who come near...
12678.zh: 基馬斯圖蘭將其邪穢污物潑向所有靠近者……

12682.en: Dionysceus, the Unholy Tower, and House of the blaspheming Danes!
12682.zh: 狄奧尼修斯，邪穢之塔，褻瀆丹恩一族之家！

12683.en: Beware, only the wicked walk through the unholy lands of Dane!
12683.zh: 當心，唯有邪惡之徒才穿行於丹恩的邪穢之地！

12686.en: The prophecy shall cleanse the evil from our lands!
12686.zh: 預言將洗淨我方國土的邪惡！

12801.en: I am Brother TShober, guardian of the Bridge to Munkharama...
12801.zh: 我是喬伯修士，通往僧侶聖地之橋的守護者……

12802.en: I shall trounce the heads of the unholy blasphemous Dane!
12802.zh: 我要痛毆邪穢瀆神的丹恩之輩！

12811.en: Master Xheng, Lord of the 5 Flowers...

12812.en: Master Xheng keeps safe the Holy Work, and walks the rightful path...
12812.zh: 鄭大師守護聖工，並行走正道……

12813.en: He is master of a secret school in Munkharama...
12813.zh: 他是僧侶聖地一所秘密學院的院主……

12816.en: Father Rulae teaches how to walk the holy path!
12816.zh: 魯萊神父傳授如何行聖道！

19603.en: find yourself in a large cavern...
19603.zh: 發現自己身在一座巨大的洞穴中……

19604.en: @The atmosphere seems breathable, though dry and a bit stale...
19604.zh: 空氣似乎可以呼吸——雖然乾燥且有點陳悶……

19606.en: fell about thirty feet above your head, a hole of light in
19606.zh: 在頭頂約三十呎處，洞穴漆黑的夜空裡

19607.en: the darkness of the cavern sky...

20600.zh: 你咬緊牙關，把雙手從窗柵之間伸進

20602.en: @Small furry paws quickly race over your hands, as if probing them
20602.zh: @毛茸茸的小掌迅速爬過你的雙手，像在探查它們

20610.zh: 啊！你手指上戴著公會的印記！%]

21000.en: A black pyramid is hooked to the end of the heavy chain, and it
21000.zh: 一座黑色金字塔吊在粗鐵鏈的末端，

21001.en: is poised over the end of the plank...

21005.en: With a heave and a grunt you hoist the black pyramid up and hook
21005.zh: 你們吆喝著使勁，把黑色金字塔拉起來，

21006.en: it on to the end of the chain...

21015.en: Stepping onto the plank, your end pivots to the floor, triggering
21015.zh: 踏上跳板，你這端翹起觸地，觸動了

21021.en: the plank, but nothing else happens...
21021.zh: 跳板，但什麼事也沒發生……

21025.en: A weighty pyramid suddenly drops onto the other
21025.zh: 沉重的金字塔突然砸向跳板另一端，

21026.en: end of the plank, catapulting you into the air...

21030.en: Having achieved the remarkable elevation of almost four feet,
21030.zh: 在達成將近四呎的驚人高度之後，

21035.en: You douse yourselves with the mysterious potion, and soon feel
21035.zh: 你們把神祕藥水潑在身上，很快感到

21036.en: tingley, and as light as a feather...

21045.en: Still propelled from your launch, you continue sailing upwards...
21045.zh: 彈射的力道未消，你們繼續向上飛翔，

21052.zh: 像一隻隻圓滾滾的氣球……

21055.en: Arising up through the shaft, you momentarily hang poised, then
21055.zh: 升出豎井的瞬間，你們懸停在半空，

21056.en: grope, and then plumment back down the open shaft beneath you...
21056.zh: 胡亂抓了一把，然後朝身下敞開的豎井直墜回去。

21060.zh: 今天真是你們的倒楣日……

21076.zh: 彩色的圓圈和一顆星星……

21080.en: Grabbing onto the rope so conveniently dangling from above, your
21080.zh: 抓住頭頂正好垂下的繩索，擺盪的動能

21081.en: momentum swings you across the water duct...

21085.en: Resting on the pad is an odd black ball,
21085.zh: 踏板上放著一顆古怪的黑球，

21086.en: about the size of an ogre's head and almost as pretty...
21086.zh: 約莫食人魔腦袋大小，長得也差不多……

21090.en: On the floor in front of you lies a square plate, large enough
21090.zh: 你面前的地板上有一塊方形踏板，

21091.en: for everyone to crowd onto it...

21092.en: @Behind the plate you can see the outline of a transparent tube,
21092.zh: 踏板後方，可以看到一根透明管子的輪廓，

21093.en: sticking down from a shaft in the ceiling...
21093.zh: 從天花板的豎井裡伸下來……

21095.en: Stepping onto the plate, you note the pad directly underneath
21095.zh: 踏上踏板，你注意到正下方有個墊子……&[]

21097.en: It appears to be connected to the plate as a kind of trigger

21100.en: Inspecting the tube, you see the pad underneath it
21100.zh: 檢視那根管子——下方的墊子

21101.en: is poised to catch anything that falls down the chute...
21101.zh: 擺好了位置，要接住任何從豎井落下的東西……

21110.en: Stepping onto the plate, you hear a slight click... &%]
21110.zh: 踏上踏板，你聽見輕輕的喀噠聲……&%]

21111.en: A large black ball drops down the hollow tube, landing
21111.zh: 一顆巨大的黑球沿著中空管落下，

21115.en: Suddenly the entire plate shoots skyward, propelling you up the
21115.zh: 突然整塊踏板衝天而起，把你們

21116.zh: 沿著頭頂敞開的豎井拋了上去……

21120.en: You fall back through the shaft and land with a crash upon the
21120.zh: 你們沿豎井跌回，重重砸在

21125.en: Coiled in the corner you discover a short thick rope, which is
21125.zh: 角落裡盤著一小段粗繩，

21126.en: securely tied to a hefty bar...

21141.en: with a long rivet through the center...

21142.en: @There are six spears in all, arranged in a circular pattern,
21142.zh: 總共六支長矛，排成圓形，

21143.en: and you discover that they can swing around on the rivet which
21143.zh: 你發現它們可以繞著固定的鉚釘轉動……

21145.en: @Looking a bit closer, it appears to be an elaborate mechanism of
21145.zh: 仔細一看，這像是某種精巧的機關——

21146.en: some kind, each spear rotating a different gear which is in turn
21146.zh: 每支長矛轉動不同的齒輪，齒輪又

21147.en: connected to more gears and so on...
21147.zh: 連著更多齒輪，層層相扣……

21148.en: @There is nothing which indicates a purpose to the spears, or
21148.zh: 沒有任何東西說明這些長矛的用途，

21149.en: what the contraption actually does, although it appears likely
21149.zh: 也不知道這玩意到底做什麼——但看起來

21150.en: that it is a locking mechanism of some kind, designed to open

21151.en: if the spears are turned in a specific combination...
21151.zh: 要把長矛轉到特定組合才會開啟……

21160.en: Lo, inside the chest you find an old preserved piece of
21160.zh: 看，寶箱裡有一張保存良好的

21161.en: parchment, carefully bundled in waxed wrappings...
21161.zh: 古老羊皮紙，仔細裹在蠟紙裡……

21170.en: You emerge from the Funhouse to find yourself in the forest,
21170.zh: 走出玩笑屋，你發現自己在森林裡，

21171.en: somewhere outside the nearby Rattkin ruins...

21175.en: The forest has grown through the cumbling ruins, and appears to
21175.zh: 森林早已長過傾頹的遺跡，

21176.en: have choked off the main entry...
21176.zh: 把主要入口堵了個嚴實……

25265.en: In the blood-filled waters the leviathan carcass slips back to the
25265.zh: 在染血的海水中，巨獸的屍身緩緩沉回

25266.en: depths, a gruesome end to the monsterous legend...
25266.zh: 深處，為這頭怪物的傳說寫下駭人的終章……

25267.en: @There'll be no trophy to adorn any marina's walls, and perhaps this
25267.zh: @不會有任何戰利品能妝點碼頭的牆面，而或許
